<document id="disputes-unauthorized">
Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆIfˆyouˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆorˆauthorize,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆitˆasˆunauthorized.ˆ##ˆFirst,ˆprotectˆyourˆcardˆBeforeˆweˆopenˆanˆunauthorizedˆdispute,ˆtheˆcardˆusedˆmustˆbeˆfrozenˆorˆreportedˆlostˆorˆstolen.ˆThatˆstopsˆmoreˆchargesˆwhileˆweˆinvestigate.ˆIfˆtheˆcardˆisˆstillˆinˆyourˆwallet,ˆfreezingˆisˆenough.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆyouˆhaveˆReportˆanˆunauthorizedˆtransactionˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆdateˆofˆtheˆstatementˆitˆfirstˆappearedˆon.ˆStatementsˆcloseˆonˆtheˆlastˆcalendarˆdayˆofˆeachˆmonth.ˆForˆexample,ˆaˆtransactionˆthatˆpostedˆinˆMarchˆappearsˆonˆtheˆMarchˆstatement,ˆsoˆtheˆwindowˆrunsˆfromˆtheˆendˆofˆMarch.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆ-ˆIfˆyourˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ-ˆMostˆinvestigationsˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆForeignˆtransactions,ˆandˆaccountsˆopenˆlessˆthanˆ30ˆdays,ˆcanˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆYourˆliabilityˆYouˆaren'tˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆreportedˆwithinˆtheˆwindow.ˆ##ˆNotˆsureˆit'sˆunauthorized?ˆUnfamiliarˆnamesˆareˆoftenˆaˆmerchant'sˆparentˆcompanyˆorˆaˆpaymentˆprocessor.ˆTapˆtheˆtransactionˆtoˆseeˆtheˆmerchant'sˆdetailsˆbeforeˆyouˆdisputeˆit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="savings-rate-change-2026">
Savingsˆrateˆchange,ˆJuneˆ2026ˆOnˆJuneˆ1,ˆ2026,ˆweˆchangedˆtheˆratesˆonˆSavingsˆPockets.ˆHereˆareˆtheˆoldˆandˆnewˆrates.ˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆBeforeˆ|ˆFromˆtheˆchangeˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ0.75%ˆ|ˆ0.50%ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ2.50%ˆ|ˆ2.00%ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ4.10%ˆ|ˆ3.75%ˆ|ˆ##ˆWhyˆOurˆsavingsˆratesˆfollowˆwiderˆinterestˆrates,ˆwhichˆcameˆdownˆoverˆtheˆpastˆyear.ˆWeˆkeptˆtheˆgapˆbetweenˆplansˆtheˆsame.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆneedˆtoˆdoˆNothing.ˆYourˆpocketsˆstartedˆearningˆtheˆnewˆrateˆautomatically.ˆInterestˆearnedˆbeforeˆtheˆchangeˆwasˆcalculatedˆatˆtheˆoldˆrate.ˆ##ˆNoticeˆWeˆemailedˆeveryˆmemberˆatˆleastˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆtheˆchange.ˆ##ˆBalanceˆcapˆTheˆcapˆdidn'tˆchange.ˆPlanˆratesˆapplyˆupˆtoˆ$100,000.ˆ##ˆThinkingˆaboutˆswitchingˆplans?ˆTheˆrateˆyouˆearnˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆUpgradingˆtakesˆeffectˆimmediately,ˆsoˆyourˆpocketsˆstartˆearningˆtheˆhigherˆrateˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆCompareˆplansˆinˆtheˆappˆbeforeˆyouˆdecide.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
ChargedˆtwiceˆforˆtheˆsameˆthingˆSeeingˆtheˆsameˆchargeˆtwiceˆdoesn'tˆalwaysˆmeanˆyouˆwereˆchargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆCheckˆifˆoneˆisˆpendingˆHotels,ˆgasˆstations,ˆcarˆrentalsˆandˆrestaurantsˆoftenˆplaceˆaˆtemporaryˆauthorization,ˆthenˆpostˆtheˆfinalˆamountˆseparately.ˆTheˆpendingˆoneˆusuallyˆdropsˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ##ˆIfˆbothˆhaveˆpostedˆIfˆtwoˆidenticalˆchargesˆhaveˆbothˆposted,ˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirst.ˆMostˆwillˆrefundˆaˆduplicateˆquickly.ˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆdoesn'tˆhelp,ˆdisputeˆtheˆsecondˆchargeˆinˆtheˆappˆasˆaˆduplicate.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆChargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆDuplicateˆfeesˆIfˆweˆchargedˆyouˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆAˆfeeˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆisˆalwaysˆrefunded.ˆ##ˆTimeˆlimitˆDuplicateˆchargesˆfollowˆtheˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwindow:ˆ120ˆdaysˆfromˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆ##ˆSplitˆpaymentsˆSomeˆmerchantsˆsplitˆoneˆorderˆintoˆseveralˆcharges,ˆforˆexampleˆwhenˆitemsˆshipˆseparately.ˆCheckˆyourˆorderˆconfirmationˆbeforeˆyouˆdispute.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
